d: Long, messy dark espresso brown hair with choppy bangs and a few stray red-tinted strands. Olive-green eyes with a sharp, defiant expression. Appears as a rebellious adolescent with a youthful but hardened maturity. Slender build. An oversized bright orange open jacket over a black cropped top, light blue denim shorts with frayed white edges, red-and-white striped thigh-high socks, grey knee pads, and black boots with gold emblems. A white and red baseball cap and a pair of small red-and-white horns protruding from the head.
